g.text: ask for the password (and a one-time code if MFA is on)
verify password and second factor, rate limited
Revoking the sessions logs the user out
on every device. Access tokens expire
unpublish every portfolio, delete the profile
delete the site pages and snapshots
delete originals and derivatives of the account
delete raw events of the portfolio
Every consumer retries until it succeeds.
The account row stays as a tombstone with
its identifier until all services confirm.
